title: Simulation 3D Actor Transform Set
text: Set actor translation, rotation, scale, 3 inputs; {Tag for actor in 3D scene, ActorTag} sets the name SimulinkActor1, {Number of parts per actor to set, NumberOfParts} sets the name, {Initial array values to translate actor per part, Translation} sets the actor initial position, {Initial array values to rotate actor per part, Rotation} sets the actor initial rotation, {Initial array values to scale actor per part, Scale} sets the actor initial scale and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.
